title: Skies of Arcadia/Items
text:
Throughout the game, you'll come into possession of numerous items which can help greatly in your quest. From healing and boosting party members to casting offensive magic, some of the items Vyse and Aika find can be indisposable.

Healing items
These items heal your party members, and can be used both during and outside of battles.

Boosting items
These items teach you new techniques outside of battle, and can improve your attributes during a fight.

Magic Boxes
These items hold magic spells that are unleashed on your enemies when opened.

Fishs
Fish are found all over Arcadia, and can heal your party members for varying amounts.
